newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Victoria Racing Club backs Tabcorp.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Victoria Racing Club backs Tabcorp.

text.p: The Victoria Racing Club, which runs some of Australia's premier horse races, on Thursday said it had offered to pay half the "exorbitant" fee demanded by race broadcaster Sky Channel of gaming group Tabcorp Holdings Ltd.

The club accused Sky Channel, owned equally by media groups News Corp and Publishing and Broadcasting Ltd, of trying to recoup the entire cost of its broadcast rights from Tabcorp, which buys the Sky service for its betting shops.

Sky Channel pulled the plug last week on Tabcorp's betting agencies, preventing their punters from watching the races live, after Tabcorp declined to meet its demand for a 264 percent increase in the original A$3 million annual fee charged by Sky.
Tabcorp says the agencies would be unviable if it agrees to the fee increase.

The club's chief executive, Brian Beattie, said in a statement that the club had offered to pay half the additional fee being sought of Tabcorp because of the "potentially damaging effect the current blackout could have on racing in this state".
